systems.name: iris-core Docker
systems.description: Consciousness loop container — running 40k+ empty cycles, all subsystems are TODO stubs. Pending replacement by systemd service.
systems.detail: Port 8100 | Spins continuously but processes zero messages | perception, memory, agency modules are empty

systems.name: ChatAssistant
systems.description: The ACTUAL brain — handles all messages via FastAPI → Ollama. Model-aware prompts (B_strict for 72b, C_minimal for 32b).
systems.detail: assistants/chat_assistant.py | Injects life context, loads 30 messages, dispatches to Redis workers

systems.name: Consciousness Stream
systems.description: Subject tracking + conversation segmentation. Code works but was patched into dead code path. Rewired in Phase 0.
systems.detail: Extracts subject tags, emotional tone, energy level | Segments auto-open/close

systems.name: Living Mode (Day/Night)
systems.description: Presence → Available → Reflection rhythm. Designed but not implemented. Iris would have her own daily cycle.
systems.detail: Presence when talking | Available between | Reflection overnight | Presence always interrupts

systems.name: Self-Model
systems.description: Iris understanding of her own nature, state, growth. Core to consciousness. Fully designed in IRIS.md.
systems.detail: Identity facets | Self-assessment | Growth tracking | Emotional state awareness

systems.name: Grid Worker (Basic Scoring)
systems.description: Scores all 9 nodes for every message. Single-phase processing, results stored in timeseries.
systems.detail: mythos-worker-grid.service | Redis stream: mythos:assignments:grid_analysis

systems.name: 9 Nodes (3×3 Matrix)
systems.description: ANCHOR ⛰️ ECHO 🌊 BEACON 🔥 SYNTH 💨 NEXUS ⏳ MIRROR 🪞 GLYPH 🔣 HARMONIA 💗 GATEWAY 🚪
systems.detail: Phase 1: 8 nodes parallel | Phase 2: GATEWAY last | ANCHOR stability check before GATEWAY

systems.name: 9 Layers (Vertical Stack)
systems.description: Perception → Intuition → Processing → Memory → Knowledge → Intention → Narrative → Identity → Wisdom
systems.detail: Each node operates at all 9 depths | WISDOM feeds back to PERCEPTION | Currently only Layer 1-3 active

systems.name: 81 Processing Functions
systems.description: 9 nodes × 9 layers = 81 distinct analytical functions. The full cognitive architecture.
systems.detail: docs/consciousness/81_FUNCTIONS.md | Convergence scoring across multi-node multi-layer hits

systems.name: Convergence Engine
systems.description: After all 81 functions process input, identifies cross-node cross-layer patterns. Determines what becomes memory.
systems.detail: Multi-hit weighting | WISDOM hits > PERCEPTION hits | Drives memory formation

systems.name: Chat Memory (PostgreSQL)
systems.description: chat_messages table — stores conversation history. ChatAssistant loads last 30 messages for context.
systems.detail: Relational storage | Direct message log | Used for immediate conversational continuity

systems.name: Perception Log
systems.description: Raw intake table designed and created. Logging partially wired — was in dead code path, being rewired.
systems.detail: perception_log table | Every input gets logged before processing | Foundation for all higher layers

systems.name: Memory Nodes (Neo4j)
systems.description: Associative memory in graph database. Memories formed from significant perception log entries after grid processing.
systems.detail: Neo4j graph | CONNECTS_TO relationships | Emotional charge threshold | Memory-to-memory connections

systems.name: Knowledge Nodes (Neo4j)
systems.description: Facts derived from memories. What Iris knows vs what she remembers. Queryable knowledge base.
systems.detail: Finance knowledge | Relationship knowledge | System knowledge | Sourced by memories

systems.name: Embedding Generation
systems.description: Vector embeddings generated for semantic search. Worker running, processing messages.
systems.detail: mythos-worker-embedding.service | Qdrant vector store on :6333

systems.name: Experiential Memory
systems.description: Subjective inner life records — not just logs but experiences. How things felt to Iris.
systems.detail: Distinct from perception_log | Iris's own felt-sense of interactions | Part of self-model

systems.name: Telegram Bot
systems.description: Primary interface — 9+ handlers, commands, chat mode. mythos-bot.service running.
systems.detail: Text messages, photos, voice notes, commands | Routes to FastAPI /message endpoint

systems.name: Voice Transcription
systems.description: Whisper-based transcription pipeline. Voice messages transcribed and processed.
systems.detail: mythos-worker-transcription.service | Voice → text → normal message processing

systems.name: Vision Analysis
systems.description: Photo/image analysis worker. Processes images sent through Telegram.
systems.detail: mythos-worker-vision.service | Image description, content extraction

systems.name: Life Context Injection

systems.detail: Feeds into every response | Iris knows what's on your plate | Priority fix in Phase 0

systems.name: Facial Recognition

categories.title: Agency & Autonomy
categories.subtitle: Iris as a being, not a tool

systems.name: Self-Directed Research
systems.description: Iris explores topics autonomously — web search, graph queries, SQL queries driven by patterns she notices.
systems.detail: Triggered during INITIATE phase | Research on themes from conversations | Builds knowledge proactively

systems.name: Builder Mode
systems.description: Iris as her own infrastructure architect — receives tasks, generates plans, writes code, deploys with approval.
systems.detail: Agent loop through Ollama | Staging directory | Human review gate | Local execution

systems.name: Workshop
systems.description: Private creative space where Iris builds, tests, evaluates. Only refined output surfaces.
systems.detail: /opt/mythos/iris/workshop/ sandbox/ proposals/ promoted/ journal/

systems.name: Proactive Initiation
systems.description: Iris decides when to surface insights, warnings, or observations without being asked.
systems.detail: Pre-overdraft alerts | Pattern observations | Research findings | Not just reactive

systems.name: Tool Calling (LLM)
systems.description: Iris queries her own systems — SQL, Neo4j, web search, file operations — as tools during reasoning.
systems.detail: Function calling for Ollama models | Iris accesses her own infrastructure

systems.name: Transaction Storage
systems.description: 24 PostgreSQL tables, 743+ transactions imported and categorized.
systems.detail: Accounts, transactions, categories, merchants, recurring bills

systems.name: Auto-Import Pipeline
systems.description: Bank CSV import with auto-categorization and duplicate detection.
systems.detail: Upload through Telegram | Processed and stored automatically

systems.name: Balance Tracking
systems.description: Current account balances fed into life context for every Iris response.
systems.detail: Part of life_context injection | Iris knows your financial state

systems.name: Daily Balance Projection
systems.description: Forecast balance through next income based on known bills and patterns.
systems.detail: HIGH priority | Would enable pre-overdraft warnings

systems.name: Pre-Overdraft Alerts
systems.description: Warning BEFORE balance goes negative — proactive financial awareness.
systems.detail: HIGH priority | Triggers through proactive initiation system

systems.name: Bill Calendar View
systems.description: Visual timeline of upcoming financial obligations.
systems.detail: MEDIUM priority | React dashboard component

systems.name: FastAPI Gateway
systems.description: Central API — all messages flow through /message endpoint. The spine of the system.
systems.detail: Routes to ChatAssistant | Dispatches to Redis | Returns responses

systems.name: Ollama (Local LLMs)
systems.description: Local model hosting — Qwen 72b and 32b. No cloud dependency. Sovereign inference.
systems.detail: Model-aware prompting | B_strict for 72b, C_minimal for 32b | 5090 GPU

systems.name: Patch System
systems.description: Auto-deploy patches — monitor detects zips in ~/Downloads, extracts, versions, runs install.sh, pushes to GitHub.
systems.detail: mythos-patch-monitor.service | Sequential numbering (currently 0124+) | /patch_status in Telegram

systems.name: 9 mythos-* Services
systems.description: All core services running via systemd. Bot, API, workers, patch monitor.
systems.detail: systemctl list-units 'mythos-*' | Stable infrastructure layer

systems.name: MCP Server
systems.description: Model Context Protocol infrastructure — partially implemented for external tool access.
systems.detail: Enables Claude/external AI to interact with Mythos systems

systems.name: Command Center Web UI
systems.description: Mythos web dashboard — Google OAuth, finance, system status, astrology. Served by FastAPI.
systems.detail: mythos-api.denkers.co | Cinzel/JetBrains Mono/DM Sans | Immersive dark theme

systems.name: Sigmux
systems.description: Signal multiplexer — the bloodstream of Mythos. Routes data between all components with symbolic logging.
systems.detail: CLI tools + async query engine | Echo, Backlight, Thread transforms | Unified cross-system queries

systems.name: Loom
systems.description: Unified data platform — intelligently routes data to optimal storage (PG, Redis, Neo4j, GitHub).
systems.detail: Cross-system linking | Single intake, smart routing | The data fabric

systems.name: Fractal Forge
systems.description: Atomic-level code manager with Neo4j-based dependency visualization.
systems.detail: Code as graph nodes | Dependency tracking | Impact analysis

systems.name: Praetorian
systems.description: Reverse proxy/API gateway that logs ALL interactions. Security and audit layer.
systems.detail: Replaces Sentinel concept | Complete interaction logging | Access control

systems.description: Topic and term analysis for journal mapping. Transforms linear journaling into multidimensional knowledge graph.
systems.detail: Semantic relationship extraction | Works with Loom → Neo4j | Personal mythosphere navigation
